architectural-decision-records.why: records the single-source-of-truth decision and how drift is made impossible
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0046: repo A gate-manifest.json is the one upstream truth, kept drift-proof by self-declaring markers + a bidirectional integrity gate; adds the machinery schema field; states the limits
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the integrity gate ships a discrimination test proven to fail when neutralized, and the schema test now validates the real manifest
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added check-upstream-manifest-integrity.mjs + a 15-case fixture test (8 of 15 go red when neutralized); extended parity and provenance to hash-check machinery too, each with new discrimination cases; extended the schema contract test to validate the committed root manifest and the machinery shape
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code (.mjs), so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: fixture-driven tests building a skills tree + manifest are the right level for a source-of-truth drift gate; no integration/e2e surface
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added .mjs; the genesis behavior assumes a single upstream truth
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: this ships the upstream manifest the genesis feature copies from and the integrity gate that keeps it faithful, each with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the manifest is the trusted record of gate-script content that genesis copies and consumers execute
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: the integrity gate hash-verifies every shipped script against its manifest sha256 and requires a self-declaring marker; parity and provenance now also hash-check machinery (the aggregator) so a neutered runner is caught consumer-side; all read-only
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that integrity proves content match not design quality, that the upstream/consumer layout mapping relies on skill+basename, and that release-publish and self-CI-wiring are deferred
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the manifest, the integrity gate, the schema change, the markers, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI meta-tooling source-of-truth decision, recorded as an ADR; no application system, data store, or resilience architecture built

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a declarative manifest plus a read-and-compare verification

release-deployment-safety.why: the release-publish of this manifest as an asset is deferred; this change deploys, migrates, and releases nothing

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration; the manifest is CI config metadata

arch-encode.why: planned enforcement machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
